factors.value_notes: A high-resolution archival-tag study of only two longbill spearfish off Ascension Island recorded SST of 23.2–25.2 °C; one fish spent 97% and the other 82% of monitored time in 22–26 °C. The study calls for broader monitoring and geographic coverage. This supports central thermal context but not the configured 20–29 °C / 23–28 °C band as a general preference.
